headline: NEW -- US-Israeli plans for renewed Iran strikes drawn up for AFTER Nov 3 midterms (Anadolu)
dek: Anadolu reports US and Israeli militaries have developed plans for renewed strikes on Iran to be launched after the Nov 3 US midterm elections; Trump's approval of those plans remains uncertain. Trump told reporters the US is 'not negotiating' with Iran and 'something one way or the other...
sources: Anadolu Agency reporting (via Outlook India); Trump remarks to reporters/NewsNation + Sioux City rally; Iranian Maj. Gen. Mohsen Rezaei
fault_line: Post-midterms strike: ending the war, or starting a bigger one?

sections.what_happened: Anadolu reports US and Israeli militaries have developed plans for renewed strikes on Iran to be launched after the Nov 3 US midterm elections; Trump's approval of those plans remains uncertain. Trump told reporters the US is 'not negotiating' with Iran and 'something one way or the other... will happen fairly soon'; at an Iowa rally he said 'we're gonna have Iran finished very soon... your gasoline prices and oil is going to come tumbling down.' Iran's Maj. Gen. Mohsen Rezaei warned that if war breaks out, undersea internet cables, data centres and AI facilities could be among Iran's targets. Guardian (via Times Now) reported Iran threatened Gulf oil installations, missile sites and nuclear facilities if strikes resume.
sections.what_verified: Anadolu (via outlookindia.com); Gulf News live blog; Hindustan Times; Times of India liveblog (NewsNation interview transcript); asianetnews (Rezaei); The Guardian via Times Now
sections.what_disputed: Trump has not approved the strikes (Anadolu itself); he earlier signaled willingness to end the war on a lasting deal; IRGC counter-threats may be deterrent posturing rather than committed intent
sections.why_matters: Trump says Iran will be 'finished very soon' — but AFTER the midterms. The calendar tells you who this is for. Meanwhile Tehran names the targets that would make the whole region pay: cables, datacentres, oil.
sections.context: Background: NEW -- US-Israeli plans for renewed Iran strikes drawn up for AFTER Nov 3 midterms (Anadolu); Trump: 'something one way or the other... fairly soon'; Iran names undersea cables, datacentres, AI facilities as retaliation targets

totw_analysis: Our read: Trump says Iran will be 'finished very soon' — but AFTER the midterms. The calendar tells you who this is for. Meanwhile Tehran names the targets that would make the whole region pay: cables, datacentres, oil. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Post-midterms strike: ending the war, or starting a bigger one?
